evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Position-holder sets a binding cadence by authority of role while supplying a definitional frame that makes the fact itself the lever — an unrehearsed rollback is declared nonexistent.
Restates the mandated cadence as a settled fact, reinforcing the authority that set it without adding new influence.
Self-assignment of the owner role is a legitimate-power claim — the position-holder names himself as accountable for the directive.

mints.name: RehearsalAsExistenceCondition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being asserted by redefining what counts as real or existing, so that compliance becomes a precondition for the thing itself?
